geometrySource: The final accepted mangrove inventory icon for each suffix
algorithm: Per-channel mean/deviation transfer from mangrove_planks to dark_planks; pixels with alpha=0 or max(rgb)<55 are preserved.
geometryInvariant: Width, height, alpha bytes, pixel coordinates, camera angle, scale and silhouette must be byte-identical to the corresponding mangrove icon.
policy: Blackwood icons may differ from mangrove only in RGB palette. Never substitute an independently rendered blackwood model.
